title: Interview (speaker name leaked from another recording)

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Thanks for coming in, Chris. Tell me about a project you're proud of.

segments.speaker: Chris
segments.text: I led the migration of our payments service from a monolith to Go microservices.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: How did you handle the cutover without downtime?

segments.speaker: Chris
segments.text: We ran both systems in parallel for two weeks and compared every ledger entry nightly.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Our team is mostly Python today, with some Rust in the audio pipeline.

segments.speaker: Chris
segments.text: I'd be happy to learn Rust. I've only used it for side projects.

segments.speaker: Maya
segments.text: Great. I'll send you the take-home assignment by Monday.

summary:
## Summary
- John described leading the payments service migration to Go microservices.
- Chris said both systems ran in parallel for two weeks with a nightly ledger check.
- Maya said the team is mostly Python with some Rust in the audio pipeline.
## Action items
